sourceDocuments.title: Soyinka and the Mythopoetics of Yoruba Tragedy
sourceDocuments.text: Wole Soyinka utilizes the Ogun myth in Death and the Kings Horseman to symbolize the perilous abyss of transition and cosmic reconciliation between mortal and spiritual realms.

studentDocument.title: Feminist Subversion in Flora Nwapa’s Efuru
studentDocument.text: Flora Nwapa reclaims feminine agency in early Nigerian fiction by demonstrating economic autonomy through commerce and spiritual devotion to the river goddess Uhamiri, defying patriarchal marital constraints.

labelRationale: Clean negative: student analyzed Flora Nwapa; source analyzed Wole Soyinka.
